cells.gaps: The one row is an audit of 22 communes over 2014-2018 finding no updated census of the taxable base and no register of receivables; it does not carry the country, is not a statement that records are kept on paper, and names no system in preparation. Every listed system is a noted class (central, survey, accounts, web), which places nothing.
cells.note: Stage 1 needs a dated statement of paper records and stage 2 a revenue system prepared or piloted; neither is in the evidence. The tax rolls for taxe foncière are drawn up centrally and the national addressing exercise is a survey, hence the two flags.
